name: deepep_post_reorder
description: deepep_post_reorder(down_output, output, src2dst, topk_ids, topk_weights, topk, hidden_size, routed_scaling_factor) -> output. down_output has shape [num_tokens*topk, hidden] and output has shape [num_tokens, hidden]; src2dst is [num_tokens, topk] int32 and topk_weights is [num_tokens, topk] float32. For each token and hidden column, accumulate sum_i down_output[src2dst[t, i]] * (topk_weights[t, i] cast to down_output.dtype as fp32 * routed_scaling_factor) over slots with src2dst[t, i] >= 0, in fp32, then cast to output.dtype. The native kernel writes the supplied output buffer in place and returns the same tensor; output is mutated and aliases the return value. down_output is read-only. topk_ids is accepted for ABI compatibility but is not used by the reorder. A zero-token, zero-hidden, or zero-topk call returns output unchanged. The exercised cases use bf16 down_output and topk 2, 4, or 8.
